question: ‘Aamar Jiban’, is the autobiography written by an Indian woman. Who was she?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rassundari Devi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Rassundari Devi** was a pioneering figure in Indian literature, known for writing the first full-fledged autobiography by an Indian woman.
 
• Her autobiography, titled **'Aamar Jiban'** (My Life), was published in 1876.
 
• Rassundari Devi was born in 1809 and belonged to a conservative Bengali family.
 
• She taught herself to read and write in secret, defying the societal norms of her time.
 
• 'Aamar Jiban' provides a vivid account of her struggles and triumphs as a woman in 19th century Bengal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Autobiography:** An autobiography is a self-written account of the life of oneself. 'Aamar Jiban' is significant as it broke new ground for women writers in India.
 
• **Women's Education:** During the 19th century, women's education was severely restricted in India. Rassundari Devi's efforts to educate herself were extraordinary and inspirational.
 
• **Bengali Literature:** Bengali literature has a rich history, and works like 'Aamar Jiban' are pivotal in understanding the cultural and social dynamics of the time.
 
• **Social Norms:** The autobiography sheds light on the stringent social norms and gender roles prevalent during Rassundari Devi's time, providing valuable insights into the historical context of women's lives.
 
• **Legacy:** Rassundari Devi's 'Aamar Jiban' is not only a personal narrative but also a historical document that continues to inspire and influence contemporary discussions about gender and literature in India.
